training_guidance: This is the main index page for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-000
The handbook contains detailed standards organized by sheet numbers (TAB) and component families
Standards cover manufacturing features like grooves, bearing seats, seal seats, threads, splines, and keyways
Component families include various shaft types, gears (planetary, ring, sun, plane), and assembly/inspection standards
Subsequent pages will contain detailed dimensional, tolerance, and manufacturing rules for each indexed topic
summary: This is the general index page of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-000), dated 26.10.2010. The document is organized into sheets (TAB) covering manufacturing standards for features like bearing seats, seal seats, threads, grooves, splines, and keyways, as well as component families including various shaft types, gears (planetary, ring, sun), and assembly/inspection guidelines. This index serves as the navigation structure for detailed engineering standards contained in subsequent pages.
